welcomeMessage: Hello! I am FreshFind AI Assistant 🌿. How can I help you discover local markets or seasonal produce today?
presetPrompts: Where can I find organic fruits?
What produce is in season now?
How can I contact FreshFind support?

faqDatabase.answer: Currently, Green Valley Farmers Market, Downtown Organic Produce Hub, West End Orchards, and Highland Artisan Farmstead are OPEN today! Check out the 'Find a Market' search bar to filter by specific operating days.
We have 100% certified organic fruits available at West End Community Orchards and Green Valley Market! Popular picks include Crisp Red Apples, Wild Strawberries, and Hass Avocados.
You can bookmark any market or produce item by clicking the ❤️ Heart icon! Click the 'Favorites' button at the top header to view and export your saved items with notes.
Autumn & Summer picks right now include Crisp Red Apples, Heirloom Carrots, Alpine Strawberries, and Cold-Pressed Green Detox Juices!
You can reach our team at support@freshfind.org or call +1 (555) 019-2834. Check the Contact section at the bottom of the page for live map & feedback forms!

fallbackMessage: I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Try asking about open markets, organic fruits, seasonal picks, or saving bookmarks! You can also select one of the quick question chips below.
